summary: web/ is the realmm-console Next.js 15 app. Three pages mount the same ConsoleShell with a different view. The browser calls the Python gateway with a Bearer token from sessionStorage. Native chat is SSE POST /chat. The OpenAI /v1 path is shown in snippets and is not the console's own chat client.

notes: Runtime dependencies are next ^15.5.4 and react ^19.1.1. No UI kit and no third-party SSE client.
Scripts: dev and start on port 3000, build, typecheck, test, test:coverage.
Vitest coverage includes app, components, hooks, and lib, excludes app/layout.tsx. Thresholds: lines and statements 90, functions 85, branches 80.
Session storage keys: realmm.gateway_key, realmm.conversation_id, realmm.model.
Default gateway URL is http://127.0.0.1:8000. Compose and web/Dockerfile set NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL to that host loopback so the browser does not use the Docker DNS name gateway.
Console JavaScript does not call POST /v1/chat/completions. That route is for agents using an OpenAI SDK.
